data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin providing Google Street View for Web, iOS, and Android applications.
data.what_it_does: Integrates Google Street View panoramas into Flutter widget trees. Allows controlling cameras, managing positions, and handling events through a controller.
use_when: You need to display interactive Google Street View panoramas within your Flutter app.
You are building an app for Android, iOS, and Web that requires location-based street imagery.
avoid_when: You only need standard flat maps without street view functionality.
You want to avoid external API keys and configuration for Google Maps Platform.
strengths: Supports Android, iOS, and Web platforms.
Provides a StreetViewController to dynamically control camera position and views.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific API key configuration and Google Maps SDK setup.
Google charges for dynamic street view instantiation on supported platforms.
data.setup_notes: Requires getting a Google Maps API key and enabling the Google Maps SDK for Android, iOS, and Web platforms, followed by platform-specific manifest/index.html configurations.
data.minimal_example:
FlutterGoogleStreetView(
  initPos: LatLng(25.0780892, 121.5753234),
  initSource: StreetViewSource.outdoor,
  onStreetViewCreated: (StreetViewController controller) async {},
)
